summary: Reject ambiguous parser inputs and enforce normalization record ownership
details: Reject duplicate decoded JSON member names before stored OpenAPI replay, DSSE envelope decoding and worker attestation interpretation.
Require the native normalization record itself to belong to the requested tenant, independently of its canonical checksum and the source/audit records.

Add four bounded properties covering structural ingestion, focused source adapters, append-only stored replay, worker parsing/metadata/finalized object checks and the versioned backup JSON row stream; register all 39 targets.

compatibility.notes: Previously accepted ambiguous duplicate-key objects now fail interpretation. Valid JSON/YAML OpenAPI inputs, unambiguous DSSE profiles, parser versions and signing/hash formats remain unchanged. Existing raw evidence is not rewritten or migrated. All five backup commitment vocabularies and historical framing/hash vectors remain unchanged.

security: Use structured duplicate-key validation and explicit tenant ownership before accepting a derived record. Structural ingestion/replay and recorded worker metadata do not assign cryptographic trust. Current storage callers retain their own tenant filters; the verifier regression does not establish external data exposure.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures and finite campaigns do not establish exhaustive coverage, live provider assurance or cryptographic security.
Bounded preview and lifecycle/object ports do not replace the required live persistence and protected hosted checks.
